issues.quote: Faint, and quick, and from the top of the house.
issues.fact: B4 says only that the faint quick bells came from the master's window up above. It does not say the window is on the top floor or that it is the top of the house.
issues.misreading: A solver could take this to place the bells at the top of the house, which could be read as the atelier on the top floor where the victim was found. That is a location the fact sheet does not give.
